items.title: Invited talk on polyspectral mean estimation at IISA 2026
items.summary: I will present invited work on polyspectral mean estimation for general nonlinear processes at the International Indian Statistical Association conference. The work develops higher-order spectral tools for inference on nonlinear and non-Gaussian time series.

items.title: First-Year Scholars misinformation project accepted at ICMLA 2026
items.summary: Work with undergraduate researchers Calvin Ibenye, Aya-Vera Jimenez, and Samuel Jaeger examines why AI-generated and human-written misinformation differ in detectability. The project grew from Kennesaw State's First-Year Scholars program and will be presented at ICMLA 2026.

items.title: ivgls released on CRAN
items.summary: The ivgls R package is now available on CRAN. Developed with Samhita Pal, the package implements network-aware instrumental-variable regression with graph-fused regularization, including procedures designed to accommodate invalid instruments.

items.title: Master's research on causal GNNs for Alzheimer's disease featured at KSU C-Day
items.summary: Pranay Kumar Peddi presented our Causal-GCN project, which combines graph neural networks with causal adjustment to study model-based influence of brain regions in Alzheimer's disease. The work uses ADNI imaging data and later appeared in the DATA 2026 proceedings.

items.title: Review of statistical and machine-learning approaches to clinical-trial efficacy published
items.summary: A review with Samhita Pal surveys classical, nonparametric, Bayesian, and machine-learning approaches to efficacy analysis in clinical trials, with attention to longitudinal outcomes, missing data, complex endpoint structures, and modern predictive methods.

items.title: Demographic distribution matching study published in Medical Physics
items.summary: Our Duke collaboration introduces DISTINCT, a distributional subsampling framework for aligning real-world and virtual phantom populations. The study connects statistical distribution matching with virtual imaging-trial design and lung-cancer screening applications.

items.title: Bot-detection paper published in IEEE Transactions on Computational Social Systems
items.summary: This interdisciplinary collaboration with William Boettcher and Rob Johnston combines temporal and semantic features from social-media behavior with machine learning and conformal prediction for uncertainty-aware bot detection.
